title: Elizondo saw Jacobs's film at AATIP

tellings.quote: he verified when he was in charge of atip he saw my my film my account

plain: Robert Jacobs, a man who has spoken about filming an object near a nuclear missile test, says Luis Elizondo told him he had seen that film while running AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports. Michels relays this second-hand, quoting Jacobs: "he verified when he was in charge of AATIP he saw my film, my account." If true, it would mean the Pentagon office knew about and kept Jacobs's footage.
